<issue>
[FEAT] DDB streams persistence
## Service

DynamoDBStreams

## API Action / Feature

ListStreams

## AWS Documentation

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/APIReference/API_streams_ListStreams.html

## Why is this needed?

DynamoDBStreamService doesn't read from the persisted files to populate its cache, so after restarting floci, the ListStreams endpoint returns an empty list. (This may be more of a bug than a new feature? Unsure on that point.)

Possibly DynamoDBService should "enable" any existing enabled streams when rehydrating its caches?

## Are you willing to contribute a PR?

- [ X] Yes (but i'm new to this stack and likely to be slow)
- [ ] No

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed find DynamoDBStreamService (java) and DynamoDbService; print full contents of DynamoDBStreamService and the parts of DynamoDbService dealing with streams, persistence/storage init (constructors, StorageFactory use), and enabling streams (calls to streamService). Also show how another service persists (e.g. storage backend getOrCreate usage).

content.content: {"summary":"No class named DynamoDBStreamService exists; the real class is DynamoDbStreamService (src/main/java/io/github/hectorvent/floci/services/dynamodb/DynamoDbStreamService.java, 258 lines). It keeps streams in memory only: no StorageBackend, no persistence. DynamoDbService takes a StorageFactory and persists tables and items through it. Stream enabling is done by DynamoDbJsonHandler, not DynamoDbService. There is no StorageBackend getOrCreate method; 'getOrCreate' in the codebase is a domain-level helper (e.g. EventBridgeService.getOrCreateDefaultBus). Full DynamoDbStreamService source was read, but the reply is limited to the key facts below.","findings":["DynamoDbStreamService.java:26-47: @ApplicationScoped; in-memory maps `streams` (key region::table) and `records` (per streamArn, capped at MAX_RECORDS=1000); only dependency is ObjectMapper via @Inject constructor. No StorageFactory or StorageBackend.","DynamoDbStreamService.java:49-73 enableStream(tableName, tableArn, viewType, region): returns the existing stream if ENABLED, otherwise builds streamArn = tableArn + \"/stream/\" + timestamp label and registers it.","DynamoDbStreamService.java:75-91 disableStream sets status DISABLED; deleteStream removes the stream and its records.","DynamoDbStreamService.java:93-132 captureEvent builds DynamoDbStreamRecord with global AtomicLong sequence numbers; it no-ops unless the stream is ENABLED.","DynamoDbService.java:34-35: fields tableStore (StorageBackend<String,TableDefinition>) and itemStore (StorageBackend<String,Map<String,JsonNode>>);
